elements.name: Cache mount exposes the raw response head and index

steps.name: the machine is booted
I wait for the shell prompt
I type "ping -c 1 example.com" on the serial console
I wait for the serial output to contain "1 packets transmitted, 1 received"
I type "cat /https/example.com > /dev/null" on the serial console
I wait for 5 seconds
I type "cat /run/httpsd/cache/index" on the serial console
the serial output should contain "example.com"
I type "cat /run/httpsd/cache/example.com/headers" on the serial console
the serial output should contain "HTTP/"
the serial output should contain "Content-Type:"
I type "cat /run/httpsd/cache/example.com/status" on the serial console
the serial output should contain "200"
